78:1.text: About what are they asking one another?

78:3.text: That over which they are in disagreement.

78:4.text: No! They are going to know.

78:5.text: Then, no! They are going to know.

78:6.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

78:8.text: And We created you in pairs.

78:10.text: And made the night as clothing

78:11.text: And made the day for livelihood.

78:12.text: And constructed above you seven strong

78:14.text: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.

78:15.text: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.

78:17.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

78:18.text: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

78:19.text: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.

78:20.text: And the mountains are removed and will be

78:21.text: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

78:22.text: For the transgressors, a place of return,

78:23.text: In which they will remain for ages

78:27.text: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

78:29.text: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

78:30.text: , and never will We increase you except in torment."
